pipeline: LfD: BC warm start (300 rule demos) -> PPO fine-tune 5M -> eval final_model

eval_bc.cmd: uv run python train_ot.py eval --model ckpt_ot/bc_model.zip -v

finetune.cmd: uv run python train_ot.py train --timesteps 5000000 --n-envs 32 --seed 0 --load ckpt_ot/bc_model.zip

eval_final.cmd: uv run python train_ot.py eval --model ckpt_ot/final_model.zip -v
eval_final.note: final not best - see paper 5.7 (reward biased by episode length)

acceptance: 10/10 success, zero failures, t_overtake <= 2.0s; training curve ep_len up-then-down (129->140->86)
curriculum_note: overtake pretrain/train use default easy=False path per paper; overtake has no --easy stage in Phase 2
